name: How Netflix Handles 2 Trillion Events Every Day - recode hive
snippet: Every single one of these actions is an event. And Netflix captures all of them from 300 million subscribers across 190 countries, continuously, in real time. The scale: 2 trillion events every single day. That's 3 petabytes of data ingested, 7 petabytes output, at a peak rate of 12.5 million events per second.
